title: Rental Loss-History Multiplier (CondoGuard)
content:
Rating supplement of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy for the unit rental charge.

**Rule.** The rental loss-history multiplier counts the claim payments issued on the CondoGuard policy fewer than 36 whole months before the day of the endorsement: it is 1.25 for two or more, 1.10 for exactly one, 0.95 for none when the policy has been in force for 36 or more whole months, and 1.00 for none when it has been in force for fewer than 36 whole months. The multiplier is applied to the sum of the tier's unit rental annual premium and the landlord liability load, before the full-year rental charge is rounded. Where that sum carries more than one rental multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the sum; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Counting.** Every claim payment issued on this CondoGuard policy, of any coverage part, dated fewer than 36 whole months before the day of the endorsement, counts once. Time in force is measured in whole months from the policy's first inception date to the day of the endorsement.

| Claim payments in the 36-month window | Whole months in force | Rental loss-history multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | any | 1.25 |
| exactly one | any | 1.10 |
| none | 36 or more | 0.95 |
| none | fewer than 36 | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical policies)

- No claim payments, 36 whole months in force: 0.95. No claim payments, 35 whole months in force: 1.00.
- One claim payment issued 35 whole months before the day of the endorsement: exactly one, 1.10. A payment issued 36 whole months before is not fewer than 36 whole months before, so it is not counted.
- Two payments on the same claim within the window: two payments, 1.25.
